From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@kestrelhealth.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Kestrel — Private deployment pricing and support questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Kestrel’s infra and ML teams liked the latency controls and the unified deploy model. A couple of procurement/finance folks asked for written clarification so we can move to an internal commercial review. High level asks:  

- Can you confirm the platform fee treatment for a 2-year committed deployment (amortized vs upfront)? We have legacy accounting limits and prefer capex-like amortization if possible.
- Volume/anchor question: we expect to start with 12 edge nodes (GPU-backed) in year 1, plan to scale to ~40 by year 2. Do you provide banded discounts on node-based commitments or only on dollar-commits? Looking for a simple table we can present to finance.
- Support tiers: Kestrel needs 24x7 oncall coverage in production + a dedicated onboarding SRE engagement (2 weeks). Can you outline what’s included in Gold vs Platinum SRE bundles?
- For non-prod/dev clusters (approx 30% of nodes), can those be excluded from the platform fee calculation or get a dev-environment discount? That materially changes our TCO.

I attached the draft term sheet procurement asked us to fill (Kestrel_TermSheet_v1.xlsx) and the SOW skeleton. James (CFO) and procurement@ are cc’d.

If we can get a templated banded pricing table (node counts -> platform fee amortization schedule -> effective per-node rate) and a written yes/no on dev-exemptions, we can fast-track to LOI.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Chen 
Head of IT Procurement, Kestrel Health
olivia.chen@kestrelhealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: James Miller <james.miller@kestrelhealth.com>, procurement@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kestrel — Private deployment pricing and support questions

Hi Olivia / team,

Thanks — glad the demo resonated. Answers below and I’ve attached a short worked example for the 12 -> 40 node glidepath.

1) Platform fee amortization: We can support a 2-year amortization schedule for accounting purposes (platform fee recognized quarterly over 24 months). It does require a 2-year commit and invoice cadence can be quarterly or annualized depending on your preference.

2) Banded discounts: We offer both node-based and dollar-based banding. Common approach (worked example attached):
- Band A: 1–15 nodes -> base per-node platform fee
- Band B: 16–35 nodes -> 12% discount on platform fee
- Band C: 36+ nodes -> 20% discount on platform fee

If you prefer dollar-commits, the band breakpoints shift slightly but we can generate either table. I’m happy to tune the breakpoints if you share expected monthly token throughput and model mix.

3) Support tiers: short summary below (full SRE scope in SOW):
- Gold: 8x5 coverage, 4h P1 response, onboarding consult (1 week), quarterly health checks.
- Platinum: 24x7 coverage, 1h P1 response, dedicated onboarding SRE (2 weeks), monthly operational review, Proactive runbooks and priority escalations.

We can include the 2-week onboarding SRE as a one-time credit for pilots under a 2-year commit.

4) Dev/non-prod discount: Yes — we can exclude up to 40% of non-prod nodes from platform fee calculation at a 70% credit (i.e., dev nodes billed at 30% of platform-fee-equivalent). That requires a tag-based enforcement and an audit during onboarding (we’ll include controls in the SOW).

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll circulate a refined term sheet that replaces placeholders with the banded table and an amortization clause.
- If Kestrel can confirm preferred invoice cadence (quarterly vs annual), I’ll produce 2 pricing scenarios.

Looping in Soojin (CS lead) and Marissa (commercial ops) to confirm SOW language and whether we can push the Band C discount to 22% for a 40+ node guaranteed commit.

PR

Hi Priyom,

Appreciate the quick answers. A few clarifying points from procurement and legal: 

- Can the amortization clause be explicit that the platform fee is payable upfront but recognized over 24 months for accounting? Our auditors prefer upfront cashflow but amortized expense recognition.
- Band C: to secure board approval we’ll need at least a 22% discount at 40+ nodes if we sign a firm 2-year commit with an 18-month minimum ramp schedule.
- Dev node credit: procurement prefers dev credits to be handled via a separate DEV SKU (so we don’t have to rely on tag audits). Can Redwood provide a DEV SKU @ 30% of platform fee?
- Onboarding SRE: we want a one-time 2-week paid engagement to be included in the MSA but not counted against the annual support retainer. If you can include an SOW line item that shows the onboarding as complimentary for pilot but billable post pilot, that would be ideal.

We attached a completed term-sheet with placeholders filled where possible. Please review and push a DocuSign-ready term sheet if we can converge.

Thanks,
Kestrel Procurement Team
procurement@kestrelhealth.com

Attachments: Kestrel_TermSheet_v1_filled.xlsx

Soojin / Marissa — forwarding Kestrel’s procurement response. Key asks: 22% at 40+ nodes (2yr commit, 18mo ramp), explicit invoice-upfront/amortization recognition, DEV SKU @ 30% platform fee, and the onboarding SRE to be complimentary for pilot (then billable).

My suggested commercial position to push internally:
- Approve DEV SKU at 30% but require tagging + monthly automated reporting to avoid manual audits (we can offer the tag enforcement as part of onboarding).
- Offer Band C at 21% standard, move to 22% only if Kestrel signs a minimum dollar-commit floor (we should ask legal to set a clawback if they fall under ramp schedule).
- Accept upfront invoice with 24-month recognition (we need finance sign-off but this is standard).
- Move onboarding SRE to be complimentary for pilot up to two weeks; if pilot converts, bill next 12-months support retainer at Platinum rates.

Can you guys confirm if legal/finance will accept a 21% -> 22% conditional increase and I’ll draft the DocuSign-ready term sheet with an explicit amortization clause and DEV SKU appended. Also confirm if Marissa can produce two invoice-cadence scenarios by EOD Wednesday so we can show James.

Thanks,
Priyom
